name: City Council Meeting Agenda
agenda_text:
NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY  BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Regular Meeting of the City Council
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive
  Westlake Village, CA 91361

  WEDNESDAY, OCTOBER 9, 2024 - 6:30 p.m.
  .

 ATTEND OR WATCH THE MEETING
 Members of the public may attend in-person in the Council Chambers or watch the meeting
 through Zoom, City Website (Live Stream) or Cable TV Channel 10. City Council Chamber doors
 open 30 minutes before the meeting start time.

 PUBLIC COMMENT/SPEAKERS
 Members of the public may express comments to the City Council in person at the meeting or
 may submit written comments before or at the meeting. Submit a Public Speaker card or Written
 Comment card to the City Clerk prior to the public comment portion of that item. Public speakers
 are limited to three minutes unless the presiding officer sets a different limit for meeting
 management purposes. An oral summary of written comments may be given at the discretion of
 the presiding officer.

 Written comments may be emailed to the City Clerk's Office at cityclerk@wlv.org no later than
 4:00 p.m. on the meeting date. Written comments will be provided to City Council prior to the
 meeting and posted at https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-Packets

 ZOOM VIEWING ONLY:
 Members of the public watching through Zoom will not have the ability to provide comments on
 agenda items. Zoom is offered strictly as an additional viewing platform. To provide comments,
 see Public Comments/Speakers section.

  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83092891902
  Webinar ID: 830 9289 1902
  One Tap Mobile:
  +16694449171,,83092891902# OR +16699009128,,83092891902#
  Telephone:
  +1 669 444 9171 OR +1 669 900 9128 OR +1 346 248 7799 OR +1 719 359 4580
 Unless the City Council holds a teleconference meeting under AB 2449 (2022) guidelines, the
meeting will not be cancelled if technical issues occur.

In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or
services, please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for
public inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business
hours and are posted on the City’s Website - https://www.wlv.org/569/City-Council-Supplemental-
Packets.

CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  Councilmembers Pearl, Halpern, McSweeney, Mayor Pro Tem
  Honig, Mayor Davis

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of September 25, 2024 City Council Regular Session meeting.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

1.  Las Virgenes Municipal Water District (LVMWD) Update – LVMWD to provide
  presentation on the Pure Water Project and waterlines on Lindero Canyon Road
  and Agoura Road.

PUBLIC COMMENTS:
Members of the public may address the City Council on non-agenda items that are within the Council’s
subject matter jurisdiction. Please observe the time limit (three minutes unless a different limit is set by the
presiding officer for meeting management purposes). Public Comments may be presented via a written
comment, see Page 1 for deadline. Complete a Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk to be called
to speak while in the Council Chambers.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:
 CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS: Reports on City Council Committee meetings held.

1.  TELECOMMUNICATIONS/IT COMMITTEE REPORT: CONSIDERATION OF
  AWARD OF CONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT FOR TRAFFIC SIGNAL
  CONTROLLER REPLACEMENT PROJECT, PHASE 1 AND DETERMINATION
  OF CEQA EXEMPTION - Determine that the Traffic Signal Controller
  Replacement Project, Phase 1, is exempt from CEQA pursuant to CEQA
  Guidelines Sections 15301 and 15061(b)(3); award a construction contract for the
  project, consisting of the base bid items plus additive alternate Nos. 1 (Lindero
  Canyon Road-Via Colinas) and 3 (Lindero Canyon Road-Russell Ranch Road), to
  Bear Electrical Solutions in the amount of $785,500.00 with construction
  contingency of $60,000; authorize the City Manager to approve change orders
  within the project contingency budget; and authorize the Mayor to execute the
  construction contract on behalf of the City.”

2.  ADMINISTRATIVE COMMITTEE REPORT – REVIEW OF ASSESSMENT DISTRICT
  REVENUE PROGRAM - Receive the information regarding estimated increases to
  the annual assessment rates for Landscape Assessment Districts 1 and 15 and
  Lighting Assessment District 1 and provide comments and guidance to staff.

PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  ADOPTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 306-24 ADOPTING BY REFERENCE LOS
  ANGELES COUNTY CODE TITLE 10 (ANIMALS) AND AMENDING WESTLAKE
  VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 3.3 (ANIMAL CONTROL
  REGULATIONS); ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION 2370-24 ADOPTING ANIMAL
  LICENSE FEES - Adopt Ordinance No. 306-24 adopting by reference Los Angeles
  County Code Title 10 (Animals) amending Westlake Village Municipal Code
  Chapter 3.3 (Animal Control Regulations) and adopt Resolution No. 2370-24
  adopting the Animal License Fee Schedule.

  ORDINANCE NO. 306-24: AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE,
  CALIFORNIA, ADOPTING BY REFERENCE TITLE 10 OF THE LOS ANGELES COUNTY
  CODE, TITLE 10 (ANIMALS) AND AMENDING THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL
  CODE CHAPTER 3.3 – ANIMAL CONTROL REGULATIONS

  RESOLUTION NO. 2370-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE ADOPTING ANIMAL LICENSE FEES ASSOCIATED WITH
  THE WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE CHAPTER 3.3 – ANIMAL CONTROL
  REGULATIONS

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective October 1, 2024 in the amount
  of $677,046.87
   GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1.  DESIGNATION OF NEW DEPUTY CITY ENGINEER AND APPROVAL
  OF AMENDMENT NO. 4 TO WILLDAN ENGINEERING CONTRACT;
  RESOLUTION NO. 2371-24 - Adopt Resolution 2371-24 appointing a new
  Deputy City Engineer and approve Amendment No. 4 to the Professional
  Services Agreement with Willdan Engineering to update the list of the firm’s
  retainer team, and authorize the City Manager to execute the amendment.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2371-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE APPOINTING A NEW DEPUTY CITY
  ENGINEER.

  2.  APPROVAL OF CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS FROM FISCAL YEAR
  2023-24 TO FISCAL YEAR 2024-25; RESOLUTION 2372-24 - Adopt
  Resolution No. 2372-24 Amending the Fiscal Year 2024-25 Budget for the
  Purpose of Continuing Appropriations from Fiscal Year 2023-24.

  RESOLUTION NO. 2372-24: A RESOLUTION OF THE COUNCIL OF THE CITY
  OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE AMENDING THE FISCAL YEAR 2024-2025 BUDGET
  FOR THE PURPOSE OF CONTINUING APPROPRIATIONS FROM FISCAL
  YEAR 2023-2024

  3.  ACCEPTANCE OF LINDERO CANYON ROAD PARKWAY LANDSCAPE
  IMPROVEMENT PROJECT; FILE NOTICE OF COMPLETION - Accept the
  Lindero Canyon Road Parkway Landscape Improvement Project and
  authorize the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” for
  the project on behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

1.  NEIGHBORHOOD BEAUTIFICATION PROGRAM UPDATE – Approve the
  updated Neighborhood Beautification Program policy and associated documents.

NEW BUSINESS: None

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, October 3, 2024 at 6:45 pm. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall.

  City Clerk
  October 3, 2024
 Agenda and Staff Reports are posted on the City’s Website- Click on Public Meeting Agendas or
